decoder: riscq/decoders/uf_decoder.c (union-find with peeling), compiled for a RISC-Q core, Lean model

inRun.circuit: rotated surface-code memory, d = 3, 3 rounds, on 17 transmons; shot 1 with 4 detectors fired

decoder_latency_ns.note: the longest decode of every workload, bits in (392 ns) + compute

decoder_latency_model.note: a + b·n above every (input bits, latency) of every workload

decoder_bandwidth.note: input bits per µs of the slowest decode (d = 5, 2 rounds, p = 0.0023)

decoder_window_rounds.note: rounds of one block a decode takes: the board hub shares 128 bits (riscq/compile.mjs); per distance d = 3: 14, d = 5: 4

classical_memory.note: the decoder core's RAM; the largest compiled image takes 3417 of its 16384 words
